_purpose: TRAINING DATA ONLY. Transcribed by eye from dewarped photos. Never to be imported into the shortages tables or treated as operational data.
_method: tools/sheet_dewarp.py flattens the photo; values are read visually. Automatic cell extraction was attempted and abandoned - see that module for why.
_confidence: high = unambiguous. low = digit legible but row or column attribution uncertain; the sheet itself is ambiguous there.
_pages: Same-date photos are DIFFERENT PAGES, not retakes - a day needs two 16-column pages to cover the fleet. Every photo must be transcribed.
_templates: Surveyed 04-07 through 06-12. The item list stabilises on 2026-04-08 and every sheet from then on carries identical product codes (BLACK APRON x2873, WHITE APRON x2864, RED APRON x2861, REG TOWELS x2720, MICRO BLUE x7432, GRID TOWELS x1936, ...). Only 2026-04-07 is a different form (BINS row, paper-first order, GREEN/BLUE/DENIM APRON, LOGO MATS, 2X3 ALL). An earlier guess that the form changed on 05-26 was wrong.
_3x10_order_warning: CRITICAL: the four 3X10 rows are NOT in a fixed printed order across sheets. Some read BLACK, COPPER, INDIGO, ONYX (05-01, 05-11, 05-15, 05-22, 05-26, 06-01) and others ONYX, COPPER, INDIGO, BLACK (04-08, 05-06, 05-27, 06-12). Row POSITION therefore does not identify the item in that band - the printed label must be read on every sheet. Anything that assumes a fixed row order will mislabel BLACK as ONYX and vice versa.

_duplicates: The archive holds byte-identical copies: 1000036270.jpg == 1000036272.jpg == 5-Photo-5.jpg, and '20260508_220352 - Copy.heic' == '20260508_220352 - Copy (2).heic'. Only one of each is recorded, so a sheet is not double-weighted. A ' - Copy (2)' suffix is a Windows duplication artifact and does NOT mean a second page; distinct pages have distinct timestamps.
_reader_reliability: Measured accidentally, before dedup was known: the 20260508_220352 pair was transcribed twice, fully independently, from the same image. The two runs agreed on 16/16 columns and 6/6 quantities exactly (48" DUST 2; WHITE SHOP TOWELS 700/300/100; SMALL INK TOWELS 60; LARGE INK TOWELS 200). They disagreed only on illegible driver initials (col1 KB vs unreadable, col12 NC vs NP, col13 AH vs AA). Quantities - the actual training signal - are read reliably; initials are the noisy field and should be treated as weak labels.
_verification: From 2026-05-06 p2 onward sheets are read twice by independent readers. Where they disagree the entry is stored with confidence 'low' and BOTH readings in the note, rather than a winner being picked. Each sheet's _verification.agreement records the outcome. IMPORTANT: agreement 'unverified' means ONLY the first reader ran - the second was killed by a session limit mid-batch. Those sheets are single-read and are NOT held to the same standard as the double-read ones; treat them as provisional and re-verify before relying on them.
_usable_flag: A sheet with usable=false has a photographic defect that makes its ITEM LABELS unrecoverable - not merely hard to read. Its quantities and column attributions are still sound and its entries carry precise grid locators in their notes, so the sheet is kept, but it must NEVER be used as labelled item training data. Re-shoot the paper to recover it.
